# exo_mailbox_plan (Resource)

Manages the MailboxPlan configuration via Set-MailboxPlan.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Maps to the -IsDefault parameter.
- `issue_warning_quota` (String) Maps to the -IssueWarningQuota parameter.
- `max_receive_size` (String) Maps to the -MaxReceiveSize parameter.
- `max_send_size` (String) Maps to the -MaxSendSize parameter.
- `prohibit_send_quota` (String) Maps to the -ProhibitSendQuota parameter.
- `prohibit_send_receive_quota` (String) Maps to the -ProhibitSendReceiveQuota parameter.
- `recipient_limits` (String) Maps to the -RecipientLimits parameter.
- `retain_deleted_items_for` (String) Maps to the -RetainDeletedItemsFor parameter.
- `retention_policy` (String) Maps to the -RetentionPolicy parameter.
- `role_assignment_policy` (String) Maps to the -RoleAssignmentPolicy parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
